description.value: Sudeten Park is a nature reserve in the Peace River Country of Northern British Columbia, located near Dawson Creek — the Mile 0 city of the Alaska Highway. Captured in Canada's national NRCan-CanVec geographic dataset, it preserves a tract of the expansive northern landscape that defines this remote touring corridor. Cyclists riding the Alaska Highway or exploring the Dawson Creek area will find it a natural waypoint in one of BC's most storied long-distance routes.
